newsitem.title: BELARUS: Lukashenko decrees 1997 Belarus budget changes.
newsitem.headline: Lukashenko decrees 1997 Belarus budget changes.

text.p: Belarussian President Alexander Lukashenko, in a decree published on Friday, amended 1997 budget figures to bring them in line with higher than forecast revenue and expenditure.
The changes reflect an annualised actual inflation rate of 5.9 percent so far this year, above the 2.0 percent envisaged in the budget.

Revenues were raised to 62.5 trillion Belarussian roubles from 36.6 trillion, and expenditures were nearly doubled to 72.6 trillion against 44.0 trillion roubles. The deficit was increased to 10.1 trillion from 7.45 trillion.

The central bank was told to issue credits of 5.05 trillion against 3.37 trillion roubles, and to raise 3.91 trillion roubles from Treasury bill sales against 2.10 trillion roubles ordered previously.
Revenue projections from privatisation of state property and from foreign credits were revised downward in the decree.
